    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/v8.3.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-10T11:25:16Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/v8.3.0"/>
    <title>v8.3.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>build:</strong> avoid settling seen preload dependencies for performance (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23446" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23446/hovercard">#23446</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e6f6b3e3119256daa837b2dc399058c8aa45b470">e6f6b3e</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li>handle CRLF line endings in code frame positions (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23219" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23219/hovercard">#23219</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9913672bee9c34a2df7fff4c2538783cd4f43b4e">9913672</a>)</li>
<li>only treat whole <code>node_modules</code> path segments as dependencies (fix <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/17467" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/issues/17467/hovercard">#17467</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23437" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23437/hovercard">#23437</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/ef0dc17ada53d1169ae5a89cb8f6482831466755">ef0dc17</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Performance Improvements</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>proxy:</strong> pre-compile context matchers at server creation (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23263" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23263/hovercard">#23263</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8abf700eeb2411d8402d08f8e2696effafdbe774">8abf700</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

    <content type="html"><h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>

<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23445" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23445/hovercard">#23445</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/fc7c104e74d35a97fa313d5dd6f1b5e7d5b26159">fc7c104</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/v8.3.0-beta.1</id>
    <updated>2026-09-07T11:38:41Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/v8.3.0-beta.1"/>
    <title>v8.3.0-beta.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>devtools:</strong> enable dev server integration (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23333" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23333/hovercard">#23333</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/68aeb8a3b5a5a2ccd505288999bae1a5e6942ee1">68aeb8a</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>build:</strong> keep hash placeholders as-is in <code>resolveFileUrl</code> hook (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23422" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23422/hovercard">#23422</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e8d6a4d3399c739772080d70c7f3c4d548a637c9">e8d6a4d</a>)</li>
<li><strong>bundled-dev:</strong> mark payload delivered on client report (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23373" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23373/hovercard">#23373</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/a6d43bc9e3464faa4d49f090e75e1ab334ffb7b0">a6d43bc</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23445" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23445/hovercard">#23445</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/fc7c104e74d35a97fa313d5dd6f1b5e7d5b26159">fc7c104</a>)</li>
<li><strong>html:</strong> don't inline preload link targets (fix <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/13355" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/issues/13355/hovercard">#13355</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23387" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23387/hovercard">#23387</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/12e709ca4df1059747db1cb7c5d1cd71aba79a24">12e709c</a>)</li>
<li>resolve the actual package root in findNearestMainPackageData for nested package.json (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23356" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23356/hovercard">#23356</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8492422b8f110625a90c702f42f30784e8cf19dc">8492422</a>)</li>
<li>shortcuts extend error (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23447" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23447/hovercard">#23447</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/4ec58d159df4a1b4799356a1fda62db88ed14752">4ec58d1</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Miscellaneous Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li>introducing <code>@e18e/eslint-plugin</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23357" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23357/hovercard">#23357</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/f79413353995a2344879014410a9128b1b9f8e9a">f794133</a>)</li>
<li>remove unnecessary comment (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23448" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23448/hovercard">#23448</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/b919a1a8b5a7c694667f993d677973f42d349458">b919a1a</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/v8.3.0-beta.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-02T08:42:32Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/v8.3.0-beta.0"/>
    <title>v8.3.0-beta.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li>accept Rolldown watch options in <code>server.watch</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23133" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23133/hovercard">#23133</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/1b5cfe3d3777d4ceb7f35fcee9d3c4279316a084">1b5cfe3</a>)</li>
<li>add closeServer and closePreviewServer hooks (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23110" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23110/hovercard">#23110</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e17d2d565b0288f169c7995adb2b192f917548e7">e17d2d5</a>)</li>
<li>add top-level <code>tsconfig</code> option (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23310" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23310/hovercard">#23310</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/93164c3530a7b4fc7bbedfb986d6afa9546cdef3">93164c3</a>)</li>
<li>add warning for unsupported hooks in plugin returned from <code>applyToEnvironment</code> hook (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23191" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23191/hovercard">#23191</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/fdef04f112aadfea40ad3c448d96a49a04c168bd">fdef04f</a>)</li>
<li><strong>cli:</strong> support naming the CPU profile via --profile [name] (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23042" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23042/hovercard">#23042</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/a500deeb6f52d93ca501a0fc612a5392b939f2f5">a500dee</a>)</li>
<li><strong>config:</strong> warn on named imports from JSON modules (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23378" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23378/hovercard">#23378</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/472385e6ec4b21e3167c7abf9769883d1c9675f8">472385e</a>)</li>
<li><strong>css:</strong> minify style tag (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23183" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23183/hovercard">#23183</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8156684572bdcf73e9d8568ed67971f0467fab60">8156684</a>)</li>
<li>searched params attached to workers are now preserved (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/22280" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/22280/hovercard">#22280</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/517b97f57ab9473e7417da856eb641d76870a56e">517b97f</a>)</li>
<li>support subpath imports in dynamic import statements (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23185" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23185/hovercard">#23185</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/b78e2f1bc1cba404c4bd9faf518d26ec85e89fc7">b78e2f1</a>)</li>
<li>use <code>import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL_*</code> for assets in JS (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/22888" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/22888/hovercard">#22888</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/4366ac468343252df6d5706361a6348afa66f9cc">4366ac4</a>)</li>
<li>use <code>import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL_*</code> for other plugins (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/22894" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/22894/hovercard">#22894</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e38f29ee48bea5ea3178faec5b78708e86f38afb">e38f29e</a>)</li>
<li><strong>worker:</strong> remove worker chunk if it's detected that it's not referenced (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/22473" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/22473/hovercard">#22473</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/924997a4bdda9115faee9bdb622fcec4fc8357f0">924997a</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>config:</strong> close bundles when generation fails (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23256" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23256/hovercard">#23256</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/6bacc956df5a76cc5653b9de4493453b953439fd">6bacc95</a>)</li>
<li><strong>css:</strong> keep newline-separated srcset candidates intact (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23265" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23265/hovercard">#23265</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/4f9d2f4dadc83191200de7d2154c957a711e8c3d">4f9d2f4</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23337" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23337/hovercard">#23337</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/d55081581ddd4d55667fef38e85d02ab7f879f15">d550815</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23404" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23404/hovercard">#23404</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/238ad811c7fb9e4730cbd317d0657867ed3447b3">238ad81</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update rolldown-related dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23338" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23338/hovercard">#23338</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/76e8082c56a2872dc8017c5672bc36cba8dcf75d">76e8082</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update rolldown-related dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23405" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23405/hovercard">#23405</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/b88256607e3a051b7bcb0b338b3c4665926b55a8">b882566</a>)</li>
<li><strong>dev:</strong> run closeBundle after buildEnd failure (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23165" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23165/hovercard">#23165</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8cb872e7fb65b03f6068923c6aa7fcf3e71baf21">8cb872e</a>)</li>
<li><strong>hmr:</strong> handle <code>import.meta.hot.invalidate</code> in virtual module (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23171" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23171/hovercard">#23171</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/616296895bd135386d35069a479a5f188c7de298">6162968</a>)</li>
<li><strong>utils:</strong> handle dot in srcset density descriptor (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23346" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23346/hovercard">#23346</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/b50e1b4a3d66128a4076e19769b2e29657985516">b50e1b4</a>)</li>
<li><strong>utils:</strong> match timestamp query parameter with proper delimiters (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23364" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23364/hovercard">#23364</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/41f3c6fff88ade015669cac5c42db946e0b6f5c9">41f3c6f</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Miscellaneous Chores</h3>
<ul>
<li>delete unused <code>PluginContainerOptions</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23382" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23382/hovercard">#23382</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/ee644014aab61e546742b862a7d7b0d6c7d67a7b">ee64401</a>)</li>
<li>use oxfmt <code>sortImports</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23319" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23319/hovercard">#23319</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/97ad042170f4c71b518239723b733dd98e8e3e76">97ad042</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Code Refactoring</h3>
<ul>
<li>delete unused <code>esbuildPlugin</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23381" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23381/hovercard">#23381</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/f40efefbb3630cdb7235286bc2b51673d9fbfc27">f40efef</a>)</li>
<li>exclude postfix from <code>__VITE_ASSET__</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/22886" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/22886/hovercard">#22886</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/a6c08e10a624bd89b78683ff1b0e8cfa1d89aa45">a6c08e1</a>)</li>
<li>remove HmrUrl concept (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23172" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23172/hovercard">#23172</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/67a680767317f8e2cb28b6b0500192f993a567cf">67a6807</a>)</li>
<li>use <code>urlId</code> of <code>import.meta.ROLLDOWN_FILE_URL</code> in wasm plugin (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/22962" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/22962/hovercard">#22962</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/92bd2a7f325ed102349cdc6c1ad4b5cd25e1d72f">92bd2a7</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Tests</h3>
<ul>
<li>add <code>renderBuiltUrl</code> change changes hash (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23118" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23118/hovercard">#23118</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/0291408b8443129ce6f6d1d440be8facabe9683b">0291408</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/create-vite@9.2.0</id>
    <updated>2026-08-24T04:58:55Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/create-vite%409.2.0"/>
    <title>create-vite@9.2.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>create-vite:</strong> add nub package manager support (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23019" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23019/hovercard">#23019</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/c31c499ca04c7557d9093291b08b6e3087df0542">c31c499</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>create-vite:</strong> update moved eslint-react plugin links in generated README (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23284" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23284/hovercard">#23284</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/1cbf7d63e14845541dcbbc8e393cfd82a0cb25b6">1cbf7d6</a>)</li>
